children: ICICI Securities's research report on Aptus Value Housing Finance

Aptus delivered a mixed financial performance in Q2FY27, with RoE sustaining at 20% and reflecting strong core operating performance. However, asset quality (AQ) deteriorated as collection efficiency (CE) declined to 98.35% (from 98.52% in Q1FY27) and the 30+ DPD bucket increased to 7.08% (from 6.87% in Q1FY27). While an ARC sale of INR 0.88bn optically compressed the GNPL ratio to 1.68% in Q2FY27, credit cost remained elevated for the second consecutive quarter at 69bps, prompting management to revise its credit cost guidance upward to 55-60bps vs. 50bps earlier. Considering likely ~20% RoE/AUM growth in FY27E and inexpensive valuation,
We maintain BUY, with a revised TP of INR 250 (earlier INR 305), valuing the stock at 2x (earlier 2.5x) Sep’27E BVPS.
